Scope rule
Core modpack candidate = a mod/add-on that creates or materially controls an in-world female mob, NPC, companion, boss, or transformation entity. Visual layer = a resource pack/CEM/model replacement. Reference-only = creator hubs, engine backends, or legacy inspiration. The master tracker keeps these classes separate so the pack can stay coherent.
Deep research additions — 2026-08-25
A second cross-platform sweep targeted names and ecosystems the first pass could miss: CurseForge/Modrinth gameplay mods, GitHub source repositories, Blockbench/.bbmodel assets, YSM and Touhou Little Maid model libraries, Planet Minecraft CEM/EMF/ETF packs, BOOTH creator hubs, and Bedrock add-ons. Verified discoveries are promoted directly into the canonical Master Index; discovery date, source and context live in each row, and no separate scour/gem staging tab is retained.
Highest-value standalone discoveries
• Waifucraft — Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1; large interactive companion and mob-waifu roster with inventories, jobs, naming and custom animations. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/waifucraft
• Monsters&Girls- legacy — Forge 1.20.1 original lineage, distinct from the tracked Fabric port. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/monsters-girls-mushroom-update
• Monsters&Girls: Secrets of Mermaids — Forge 1.20.1 aquatic expansion with two mermaid species, Crab Girl and Microspinus. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/monsters-girls-secrets-of-mermaids
• Monsters&Girls: Hidden in Shadow (FANMADE) — Forge 1.20.1 cave expansion with five mechanically distinct cave girls; current 1.20.1 Forge release 2.0.5 uploaded 2026-07-30. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/monsters-girls-hidden-in-shadow-fanmade
• Monster_Girl_Mythology — Forge 1.20.1 bestiary with 20 girl-themed mobs and unique drops/items. https://modrinth.com/mod/monster_girl_mythology
• Jeri’s Enderwomen — Forge 1.20.1 / NeoForge 1.21.1; personality, taming and companion-bracelet behavior. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jeris-enderwomen
• My girlfriend Laura | Laura Compagne — deep companion NPC with 200+ dialogue interactions, inventory and dynamic reactions. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/laura-compagne
• Female Zombies — Forge 1.20.1 actual female-zombie entities, distinct from texture-pack replacements. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/female-zombies
• FantasyEnding (梦幻终焉) — Forge 1.20.1 hidden boss gem whose Ultimate Order Manager supports a configurable wither-girl form. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fantasy-ending
Bedrock gems
• Touhou Little Maid BE — Bedrock port with maid jobs/combat/farming plus custom-model switching and an open GitHub source ecosystem. https://mcpedl.com/tlmbe/ • https://github.com/ENIACJushi/TouHouLittleMaidBE
• Anime Waifus — current 26.30 companion set with Waifu Core menus, armor, stats/customization and pickup features. https://mcpedl.com/anime-waifus/
• Aria Girlfriend Companion — custom 3D companion with dedicated textures/animations and owner-defense behavior. https://mcpedl.com/aria-girlfriend-companion/
• Comes Alive Bedrock Edition — unusually deep companion controls including gathering, mining, teleport, talk, switch and persistence. https://mcpedl.com/comes-alive-bedrock-edition/
• Chibi Waifus Addon — 40 girl companions. https://mcpedl.com/chibi-waifus-addon/
Model / Blockbench / source gems
• Sparkle’s Morpher — universal custom-model loader with direct .bbmodel parsing, YSM/Figura support, animations, sounds, multiplayer sync, entities, vehicles and projectiles. https://github.com/sdf123098/Sparkle-Morpher
• Yes-Steve-Model-Repo — large upstream character-model archive. https://github.com/Elaina69/Yes-Steve-Model-Repo
• YSM-Model — actively maintained free YSM model library. https://github.com/sdf123098/YSM-Model
• UOM_Chan_Repo — dedicated female Ultimate Order Manager model asset for FantasyEnding. https://github.com/V-OSH/UOM_Chan_Repo
• Akatsuki Taisho Wine Fox — Touhou Little Maid fox-girl maid model pack with editable .bbmodel source. https://github.com/Bluelgin/Akatsuki-Taisho-Wine-Fox
• FREE-YSM-AUTHOR / YSM-Model-Author — already tracked, but now verified to contain explicit Blockbench source projects and TLM Maid Pack material. https://github.com/nekohalawrence/FREE-YSM-AUTHOR
• BOOTH LittleMaidMob ecosystem — a large Japanese creator pool of multi-models, textures and sounds; NELLNELU ModBox is a particularly deep free catalog. https://booth.pm/en/search/littleMaidMob?sort=price_asc&tags%5B%5D=%E3%83%9E%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%82%AF%E3%83%A9%E3%83%95%E3%83%88
Visual-layer gems
• Curvy Villagers — current OptiFine CEM / EMF-ETF custom 3D villagers. https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/curvy-villagers/
• MaNieto’s Wayfu Pack — current-generation broad custom-model visual pack. https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/track-ia-s-player-models/
• Waifu Mobs V2 — broad Bedrock mob/armor visual conversion reference. https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/waifu-mobs-v2/
• Cute Spider Girls — animated spider/cave-spider girl replacement mod for NeoForge 1.21.1; visual rather than new AI. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cute-spider-girls
Current-source refresh
Deep-hidden gem sweep — 2026-08-25
A third gap-directed pass targeted projects whose names do not advertise female-mob content, mythology/archetype terms, Touhou Little Maid dependency graphs, robot-companion lineages, legacy Forge/Fabric releases, Bedrock creator families, and non-English discovery routes. Forty verified projects were deduplicated, ranked, and promoted directly into the canonical Master Index, taking it from 262 to 302. Final search waves mostly collapsed into repeats, player-origin packs, or weak/noisy matches, so those were excluded rather than padding the catalog.
Standout additions include EvoWaifuCompanions; TC315 Creature Set MC Edithion; Lovely Robot: Reboot; Maid Logistics Network; Touhou Little Maid: Senju; Contract Blade; TLM: True POWER; MaidsConstruct; Snow Waifu Spell; SAM Automatons; XfoxSword; Waifus and Ores; Dream Waifu mod; Waifu Robotics; Cursed Mob Waifus; The Waifus Party; Mita - Interactive Anime Companion; Lovely Robots; Waifus Alive; Ex Mermaids; Tameable Arachne; and Kasukabe Tsumugi Follower. The Master Index remains authoritative for exact ranking, versions, roles, source links, and compatibility notes.
Monster Girl, the top-ranked existing master entry, received a 1.20.1 Forge 2.7.0 update on 2026-08-24 adding a Succubus and additional taming-related content. The Fabric Monsters & Girls port also has a direct MIT-licensed source repository at https://github.com/heria-zone/monsters-girls.
